outcome: composite adverse neonatal outcomes (NICU admission, neurological morbidity, hypoglycemia, ventilation, respiratory distress syndrome (RDS), phototherapy, sepsis, blood transfusion, neonatal death)
placental outcomes (size, rate of placentas below 10th percentile, MVM lesions)
cohort: The study included women with appropriate-for-gestational-weight (AGA) neonates, who were diagnosed with GDM or PET, and divided into three groups: GDM, PET, and GDM + PET.
finding: Composite adverse neonatal outcomes were significantly lower in women with coexisting GDM + PET compared to women with confined PET.
